card.name: The word with after "patients"
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "in patients", mostly in aliskiren warnings that go on to name diabetes or kidney impairment. It also fires weakly on a comma in a list of severe outcomes and on odd name or citation breaks.

modes.label: Patients with (condition)
modes.description: "with" after "patients" in a warning about a patient group, such as diabetes, heart failure or reduced kidney function.
modes.example: Do not co-administer aliskiren with Lisinopril and Hydrochlorothiazide Tablets in patients<< with>> diabetes.

modes.label: Comma in outcome list
modes.description: A comma in a list of serious outcomes after a condition.
modes.example: leading to seizures<<,>> coma, respiratory arrest, or death

modes.label: Scattered web text
modes.description: Odd breaks inside a name or a Bible verse citation.

card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where a patient group, like those with diabetes, is about to be named.
